listing.eventDescription: One package with name, description, downloads, and last publish date, but no public email or repository.

lead.eventDescription: A package with a public maintainer email or a repository link, plus downloads, homepage, and last publish date.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: A package with a public maintainer email and monthly downloads at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, active maintainer. The first qualified lead per run is free so you can validate output.
